d: Kabhi tez behte paani ka khatra, kabhi jaanleva terrain, toh kabhi nature ka badalta mizaaj! Adventurer Bear Grylls ke saamne har location par ek naya aur khatarnak survival challenge hai. Yukon ki thandi wilderness se lekar South Dakota ke khule maidaanon, Baja Desert ki tapti garmi, Oregon ke rivers, Ireland ke rugged landscapes, Belize ke jungles aur Turkey ke challenging terrain tak, har jagah survival aasaan nahi hone wala. Kya Bear apne survival skills ke dum par har mushkil se nikal paayega?
